sloka: महा उदरस्य च तथा विरूप अक्षस्य चैव हि ।विद्युज् जिह्वस्य भवनम् विद्युन् मालेः तथैव च ॥५-६-१९॥
transliteration: mahā udarasya ca tathā virūpa akṣasya caiva hi ।vidyuj jihvasya bhavanam vidyun māleḥ tathaiva ca ॥5-6-19॥

translations.english: The great vanara leaped from Mahodara's to Virupaksha's, from Vidyujjihva's to Vidyunmali and then to Vajradanstra's.
